study_identification_part.si_4_title: Normative Modeling of Thalamic Nuclear Volumes and Characterization of Lateralized Volume Alterations in Alzheimer ' s Disease Versus Schizophrenia

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Cohorts listed in the study: HCP DEV, HCP EP, HCP YA, UCLA, SCZ AH, HCP AGE, ADNI.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "Unprocessed T1-weighted images and clinical measures were accessed from 7 cohorts (HCP DEV, HCP EP, HCP YA, UCLA, SCZ AH, HCP AGE, and ADNI)"
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Young2024.pdf.md: Methods and Materials / Imaging Datasets

answer.HCP-D: control cohort for normative model training

answer.HCP-EP: controls for normative model training; early psychosis cases for clinical comparisons

answer.HCP-YA: control cohort for normative model training

answer.UCLA: controls for normative model training; schizophrenia cases for clinical comparisons

answer.SINGLE-SITE: controls and SCZ with/without auditory hallucinations for clinical comparisons (SCZ AH cohort)

answer.HCP-A: control cohort for normative model training

answer.ADNI: controls for normative model training; EMCI/LMCI/AD cases for clinical comparisons

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Normative models were trained on control samples; case groups in the same cohorts were used for z-score and clinical analyses.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "Unprocessed T1-weighted images and clinical measures were accessed from 7 cohorts (HCP DEV, HCP EP, HCP YA, UCLA, SCZ AH, HCP AGE, and ADNI)"; "The model with the best overall performance ... was selected and trained on all control samples for each region."; "Of these 2954 participants, 2374 ... belonged to their respective control groups, and 580 carried one of the following phenotypic labels related to AD or SCZ: early mild cognitive impairment (EMCI)... AD... SCZ..."

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Controls aggregated across cohorts (HCP DEV, HCP EP, HCP YA, UCLA, SCZ AH, HCP AGE, ADNI); final model trained on all control samples.
